svg.title: Dial Panel · A · IGNITION · release drawing
svg.desc: Front, side and three-quarter views of the printable Dial Panel in the A · IGNITION scheme, projected from the verified CAD, with dimensions, callouts and the printed parts list.
svg.text: SLASHBUILDER · OPEN HARDWARE · DIAL PANEL · RELEASE DRAWING · PROJECTED FROM THE VERIFIED CAD · 2026-09-21
It's a sunrise. For the entryway or the kitchen: it greets you.
speaker cup · wall cleat · receiver rail
fits a 250 × 210 bed and prints without supports; two modules bolt together
one dial: turn to move, push to open; home again after ~8 s idle
the rocker breaks the mic's USB power; the gold tab sits beneath it
set by the band insert you print and one setting; the body is the same
CAD-verified, not yet printed or fitted; software not written yet
LINEWORK PROJECTED FROM THE STEP FILES · SCREEN IMAGE, BAND GLOW AND WALL WASH ARE ILLUSTRATIVE · ONE TEAM PER DEVICE, FOR LIFE
